findings.evidence: `code/EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:64` `def delta (K : ExclKinematics V) : V := K.pPrime - K.p`; `:68` `def tMom (g : Bilin V) (K : ExclKinematics V) : ℝ := g K.delta K.delta` vs `code/EpsilonEridani/Particles/Parton/GPD/Kinematics.lean:142` `def delta : Vector d := K.p' - K.p`; `:147` `def tMom : ℝ := ⟪K.delta, K.delta⟫ₘ`. `ExclKinematics` has no other consumer in the repo (grep `ExclKinematics` matches only its defining file plus the new docstring reference).
findings.fix: Factor the hadron-transfer variables once: expose `delta`/`tMom` as functions of the pair `(p, p')` and a `Bilin V` in `DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean` (or instantiate `Bilin (Lorentz.Vector d) := minkowskiProduct`) and have both `ExclKinematics` and `OffForwardKinematics` use them, so `t` has a single definition. If the layering forbids the import direction, at minimum state the identification and prove the bridge lemma `K.tMom = ExclKinematics.tMom minkowskiProduct ·`.
findings.issue: `OffForwardKinematics.delta` (`p' - p`, line 142) and `tMom` (`⟪Δ,Δ⟫ₘ`, line 147) duplicate the existing `ExclKinematics.delta` and `ExclKinematics.tMom`, which are the same two formulas over an arbitrary `Bilin V`; the library now carries two unrelated `tMom`s for the same invariant `t = (p'-p)²`, with no bridge. The module docstring (line 45) only disambiguates `skewness` vs `xiSkew` and says nothing about this.

findings.evidence: grep `^@\[expose\] public section` under `code/EpsilonEridani` → 121 files; grep `^public section` → only `Particles/Parton/GPD/Kinematics.lean` and `Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean`. grep `_def .*:= \(rfl\)` → only these two files. `tZero_def` occurs only at its own definition (line 73); lines 77, 81, 86, 93 unfold `tZero` directly.
findings.fix: Switch both new files to `@[expose] public section` (as in e.g. `GPD/Basic.lean:30`) and delete all seven `_def` lemmas, rewriting their uses to unfold the definition directly — the file already does this for `tZero` (`rw [tZero]`, `simp [tZero]`).
findings.issue: Seven lemmas restate the definitions up to defeq: `tZero_def` (73), `avgMomentum_def` (139), `delta_def` (144), `tMom_def` (149), `skewness_def` (154), `transverseDelta_def` (160), and `ofTimeAndTwoSpatial_def` (MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean:67). They are needed only because these two files use bare `public section` instead of the `@[expose] public section` used by every other file in the repo. `tZero_def` is not used even inside the file.

summary: The t₀(ξ) bound, the physical region and its attainability are genuinely new, but the PR re-defines the hadron-side `delta`/`tMom` that `ExclKinematics` already provides, and adds seven `rfl` restatements of its own definitions that exist only because the file departs from the repo-wide `@[expose] public section`.
